text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some time has passed since I officially
became Mejiro Palmer's
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Okay, one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's gratifying to see just how much she's
enjoying her newly awakened
running
style.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Similar to how many run in freestyle
races,
she gives it her all right
from the start and
never lets up.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hraaagh! Y'all better stop screwin' around
if you wanna win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Tch! Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... phew! Sheesh, this really is just so fun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she's to keep running without ever
hitting the brakes, then learning
some
good power distribution techniques will be
essential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Any changes I introduce won't be too
drastic, however. I never want
to see that
smile on her face fade away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I've still got gas in the tank!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Okay, here goes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I never want to keep her from running the
way that makes her happy.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Isn't that style way too reckless?

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
While it's definitely important for
them to have fun while running,
that's no way to go
about winning. It's just so...
unconventional.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
There has to be a more sensible way to
approach a front running strategy. Right
now, it seems like she just runs straight
ahead without
any kind of plan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And what would that entail, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... phew!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every race has its rules. Plus, all racers
seek out a way to run that's
unique to
them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some may see certain runners as reckless
and unconventional. Is it
really my place to
police that?

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
You should put a stop to it while you
still
can. You're doing this for
her sake, aren't
y—

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if they can't see it now,
it's my duty
to have everyone
acknowledge that this is
how Mejiro Palmer rules the track.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I saw you talkin' to that other trainer
earlier. You seemed to be
frowning big
time. Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha! That's gotta be because you're so
approachable! So she
needed advice and
you were deep in thought?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait,
don't tell me... 'Twas a confession of
love? So your lucky day
finally rolled
around! Oh Trainer, you devil, you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I see. A complaint, huh? But if she
needed to say something
during our
training session...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Then it must've been about me and my
runnin', huh. Makes sense! I
can't say I
don't get where she's coming from.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(I mean,
I know that my new style is pretty
crazy, but to see Trainer
get called out for
it...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So hey, Train—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Right?! It's just as you say!
Together... we're gonna show
them what
I'm made of!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We raise both hands high into the air—
as if we're aiming to raise the
roof. The
resounding echo of a high five soon
follows.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter what anyone says, and even if
they laugh in our faces... I've
promised to
keep pushing us forward, no matter what.
